notes.title: Release Date Moved
notes.notes:
Release date of VolleyBrawl has now changed to December of this Year.

It is my extreme regret not being unable to deliver the game on time. And I apologize to anyone expecting the game to be release soon.

Just to be transparent about it, a month ago, I got hired by a different company. VolleyBrawl was a big factor of me being hired and I think it was all because of the Steam Summer Event. So thank you Steam! It was good news for me but bad new for the game. Although my new company encouraged me to finish making VolleyBrawl, I don't think I can do that at the moment. I also want to give my best to them and my new job should be my top priority.

So that, plus I need to move to Toronto next month, which is why I am busy at the moment, and I don't have time to continue developing the game.

Once things settle down, I will work on the game again. The game is almost done. That's why I predict that by December VolleyBrawl should be ready.
